author: Benjamin Geoffroy Dit Belhumeur
title: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted
content: Children's Picture Book Illustrator Wanted: First Book of a New Series. Belhumeur Books is looking for an illustrator for the first book in a new children's picture book series. Soft, expressive, cinematic storytelling. Pay: $3,000 flat for book one in four $750 milestones. Two shortlisted finalists each get $100 for a paid test. Apply by emailing belhumeur.books@gmail.com with portfolio link, samples of same characters across scenes, about yourself, availability, and confirmation work is original and human-made (no generative AI). Hire by November 1, 2026.

title: Looking for Long-Term Artist for ASMR RP Thumbnails
content: (ENG/TAG OK!) LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM ARTIST! Hello! I'm an ASMR RP creator on YouTube based overseas, and I'm looking for a reliable long-term artist to work with on a weekly basis for thumbnails and videos! Limited budget, hoping for artist whose rates are a good fit for ongoing weekly commissions. Looking for weekly character art - 1x Simple rendered anime-style bust up or half body art of my OC per week. Must be over 18, can commit weekly. Reply with commission rates and examples (add any flower emoji). Contact via group replies.

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. Talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures. Experience with illustrated lettering a plus. Paid gigs. Human-created artwork only, no AI. Email Craig Groshek with portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek@chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST.
